create_Lfm2MoeConfig: create an Lfm2MoeConfig instance with MoE parameters like num_experts and num_experts_per_tok
build_config_validate_layer_types: build an Lfm2MoeConfig that validates layer_types length matches num_hidden_layers
get_full_attention_layer_ids: get the indices of full attention layers from Lfm2MoeConfig layer_types
get_linear_layer_ids: get the indices of conv or short_conv layers from Lfm2MoeConfig layer_types
get_mamba2_cache_params: get Mamba2CacheParams with state shape and conv layer ids from Lfm2MoeConfig
